author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Customers can now be linked to the agent they buy through. Agents (customers that others link to) get a purple Agent tag in the list and on the Overview, clients show a Buys through agent tile, and the Overview has a Clients through agents card that also flags agent clients with no agent linked. Agents are left out of the no-assets note.
